school.name: High School of World Cultures
school.overview: High School of World Cultures is designed to support new arrival and multi-language learners to develop the 21st century skills required for their success as global citizens. Our English as a New Language program, BUILD Entrepreneurship program , and CTE Culinary Arts program enrich our students' academic experience and prepare them for their post-secondary career choices. Our teachers build on students' rich identities and cultural backgrounds to assist them in their transition and adjustment to their new academic environment. In the past years, many of our students have graduated with Biliteracy, CTE and Civics for All endorsements and receive numerous scholarships. Our school is located in the James Monroe Campus well known for hosting some of the strongest PSAL sport teams in the city. We, at High School of World Cultures, welcome students of all cultural identities to enrich our school community and be part of our legacy as agents of social change.

programs.name: High School of World Cultures (X09X)
programs.eligibility: Open only to New York City residents who currently identify as English Language Learners (ELL) and who have lived in the continental United States fewer than one year.
programs.description: We offer a range of English as a New Language (ENL) services, including a Transitional Bilingual program in Spanish and stand-alone ENL services.  Students have a choice in 10th grade from the CTE in Culinary Arts program, BUILD Entrepreneurship program or Visual Arts sequence.  All students have the option of participating in Advanced Placement courses.
